workflow_pattern: This is a 'F7_pure_automation' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: create repository, add readme with content, create workflow keyword based labeling, validate automation with test issues. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question:
Hi! I'm a student building a repo that auto-labels issues by keyword. Could you please help me create a new project repository named keyword-triage-bot? I need to initialize it with just the main branch and include an initial README.md file with the content "# Keyword Triage Bot

A repository to test GitHub automation for triaging issues by keyword." I'm really struggling with GitHub automation. Could you help me develop a script that automatically labels new issues by keyword, but with two conditions I want to combine: label the issue "urgent" if the title contains "crash" OR contains "down" (either keyword alone should trigger the urgent label), and label the issue "docs" if the title contains "typo" AND does NOT already contain the word "fixed" (so a title mentioning both typo and fixed should NOT get the docs label). After we set up the automation script, I need to test it with issues that clearly exercise these OR/AND boundaries: titles "server crash on startup" (should get urgent, via the crash branch of the OR), "database is down again" (should get urgent, via the down branch of the OR), "fix typo in docs" (should get docs, since it has typo and no 'fixed'), and "typo fixed in changelog" (should get NO label at all, since it has typo but also has 'fixed', which the AND-with-negation excludes). I'm really grateful for any help you can provide!
